purpose: 探索错配第二参考图能否作为负控制，校准多参考二分类重排分数
primary_comparison: rcr_alpha1 minus labelled_dual on canonical-set AP@10
mechanism_prediction: dual-minus-sham margin should be larger for labelled positives than explicit negatives
derivation: For binary True/False logits, VCD with alpha=1 induces adjusted log-odds 2*m_true_view-m_negative_control_view.
ranking: stable rerank of the same frozen top20; ranks 21-50 unchanged
confirmatory_gate: Only if the fixed primary score improves pilot AP@10 and mechanism direction agrees; then preregister untouched reserved reference components before any new scores.
novelty_boundary: Visual Contrastive Decoding already uses (1+alpha) logits from an original image minus alpha logits from a distorted image for generation.
Contextual calibration and PMI-style scoring already subtract content-free/domain-conditioned priors.
P032 tests a task-specific negative-control construction for multi-reference retrieval; it is not yet a contribution.
limits: One sham reference per query gives a noisy estimate of nuisance response.
The sham assignment couples reference groups, so intervals are descriptive.
Candidates can recur across queries; reference-component bootstrap does not remove every candidate-level dependence.
The PinPoint pilot contains 48 selected reference components and is not a full benchmark evaluation.
